content.short: Lime Game is an interactive mini-game within the iMe messenger that rewards users with $LIME tokens.
content.description: Lime Game is a dedicated gaming experience integrated directly into the iMe Messenger ecosystem on the TON blockchain. It allows users to participate in engaging gameplay and complete various challenges to boost their holdings of the $LIME token. By merging entertainment with the platform's native economy, Lime Game provides an interactive way for users to engage with iMe's SocialFi features. It highlights the potential for messaging apps to host rewarding and integrated gaming experiences that provide direct value to their community within the TON network.
content.meta: Boost your $LIME rewards with the Lime Game on iMe. Play and earn on TON via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
content.pageTitle: Lime Game - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
